## Overview

Computes the arrow position for a surface already positioned at `surface`.
`anchor` and `surface` are viewport-relative rectangles.

- **Kind:** Function
- **Source:** [packages/core/src/overlay/overlay-arrow.ts:66](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/core/src/overlay/overlay-arrow.ts#L66)
